panels.title: Turn rate by outcome
panels.description: A turn is the unit a user waited for. Not the same as a request (one request can fail before the graph starts) and not the same as a model call (one turn can make three).

panels.title: Turn latency
panels.description: p50/p95/p99 across the whole turn: retrieval, every model call, every tool.

panels.title: Turn failures by domain error
panels.description: Whose problem it is. ProviderNotConfiguredError is the operator's, ModelConfigurationError is a tenant's, RetrievalError is neither's until you look.

panels.title: Tokens per second by model
panels.description: Prompt and completion split, because they price differently and move for different reasons: prompt grows when retrieval or history grows, completion when answers get longer.

panels.title: Provider latency p95
panels.description: Time waiting on the provider for one call. The gap between this and turn latency is retrieval plus tools.

panels.title: Model calls per turn
panels.description: Above one means the tool loop is running. A drift upward is a prompt or a toolset making the model work harder for the same answer.

panels.title: Best-match score distribution
panels.description: The panel this chunk exists for. Retrieval has no relevance floor because the right cosine threshold is embedding-model dependent and a bad one silently breaks retrieval — so the decision was deferred until it could be measured. This is the measurement: where real best matches actually land.

panels.title: Searches that found nothing
panels.description: A search returning zero chunks means the agent answered ungrounded, or refused to. Sustained non-zero is an empty collection or a broken ingest.

panels.title: Tool calls by outcome
panels.description: `unknown`/`denied` is the allowlist refusing a call the model invented or an injection suggested. Non-zero is worth reading the logs over — the name is there, not here.

panels.title: MCP discovery cache hit ratio
panels.description: Discovery is a round trip per server per model call. If this is not near one, the TTL is too short or servers are being edited constantly — and the deferred connection pool starts to look worth building.

panels.title: MCP discovery failures
panels.description: `blocked` is the platform refusing to dial a URL that resolves somewhere private. `error` is a tenant's server the platform tried to reach and could not.

panels.title: Requests by route
panels.description: Route templates, never paths. One series per endpoint, not one per agent.

panels.title: Open streams
panels.description: Responses still being written — in practice, live SSE conversations. Watch this before draining a pod: every one of them is somebody mid-answer.
